podcast.title: Collaboration with Ryan Dahle and Steve Bays
podcast.body: Hawksley Workman is actively involved in a new band named Mounty, alongside Ryan Dahle (Age of Electric, Limblifter) and Steve Bays (Hot Hot Heat). This collaboration signifies his continued presence in the Canadian music scene through new projects. "Ryan Doll was now working with Hoxley Workman and Steve Bayes of Hot Hot Heat in a band called Mounty."

xref.title: Formation of New Band
xref.body: Mounty is a recently formed band comprising Ryan Dahle (from Age of Electric and Limblifter), Hawksley Workman, and Steve Bays (from Hot Hot Heat). This supergroup-like formation brings together talent from several prominent Canadian rock bands. "Ryan Doll was now working with Hoxley Workman and Steve Bayes of Hot Hot Heat in a band called Mounty."
